summary: Phase B-3 wrap-up (Team Calendar) fully validated. Backend pytest (test_team_calendar.py) passes (window/filter/reversed-range/bad-date). Frontend E2E on Bright Beans Coffee Co. (pro@axiom.ai) confirmed /team/calendar mounts, 42-cell month grid renders with Mon-Sun headers, today cell highlighted, Month/Week toggle works (week has 7 cells), Prev/Next/Today nav updates period label ('August 2026' → 'September 2026' → back), employee filter populated with Sarah K, all four chip types render (calendar-task, calendar-phase-start, calendar-phase-end, calendar-hours in month; calendar-time in week), counts (1 tasks / 1 phases / 1 time entries), sidebar Team → Calendar link present and routes correctly. Employee filter narrowing behaves as designed (Sarah K has no user_id → tasks drop to 0 while her time entries stay).
critical_code_review_comments: Employee filter behavior when employee.user_id is null: currently maps to sentinel '__none__' so tasks become 0 even though the employee is real (Sarah K case). Consider surfacing a UI hint or, better, matching tasks by employee_id when user_id is missing so managers whose employees lack a linked user still see task overlays.
monthWindow/weekWindow rely on Date.UTC; days near DST/timezone boundaries are safe, but the todayISO() uses local time — a user in UTC-12 could see the highlight one day off. Minor edge case.
team_calendar.py phase overlap $or is correct but redundant: the first clause already covers phases 2 & 3. Not a bug, just noise.
